about: Shared trigger cases for the hint rules (autonomy design §13; design 24 #686 parity). Each client's test maps the abstract steps onto its own tool events: shell = a shell command with its exit status and output; write = one file written by path; patch = one multi-file patch naming these paths; prompt = a user prompt; recall / delegate = a call to the companion's recall or delegate tool. Paths are relative to the session's working directory unless absolute. activate turns on hints the catalogue ships inactive; mute lists hints the project muted. fired and followed are the hint ids expected at the end, in any order.

cases.name: a successful git commit fires commit.review
assignments before git commit still count

a passing runner reporting zero failures does not fire
a failing command that is not a runner does not fire

a design document named in upper case under docs is a design document

a design written by a shell command that then failed still fires
